editingGuide.howToAdd: Copy any achievement block, give it a unique 'id', and add it to the 'achievements' array. Restart the app to pick it up.
editingGuide.howToRemove: Delete the achievement block. Already-earned localStorage entries will be silently ignored.
editingGuide.idWarning: Never change an 'id' once shipped — it is the localStorage key for unlock tracking.

conditionTypes.owned_count: { type, min }                     — total owned non-base skins >= min
conditionTypes.chroma_count: { type, min }                     — total owned chromas >= min
conditionTypes.legacy_count: { type, min }                     — owned legacy skins >= min
conditionTypes.prestige_count: { type, min }                     — owned skins whose name contains 'Prestige' >= min
conditionTypes.rarity_own: { type, rarity }                  — own at least 1 skin of this rarity (transcendent/exalted/ultimate/mythic/legendary/epic/standard)
conditionTypes.champion_complete: { type, champId, minSkins? }      — all non-base skins owned for a champion (champId 0 = any; minSkins default 3)
conditionTypes.skinline_complete: { type, lineId, minSkins? }       — all skins in a skinline owned (lineId 0 = any; minSkins default 3)
conditionTypes.specific_skins: { type, mode, skinIds }           — mode 'any' = own at least 1; mode 'all' = own every listed skinId
conditionTypes.chroma_complete_any: { type }                          — own all chromas for at least one skin
conditionTypes.wishlist_count: { type, min }                     — current wishlist has >= min skins
conditionTypes.wishlist_history: { type, min }                     — own >= min skins that were ever added to wishlist
conditionTypes.rp_value: { type, min }                     — estimated collection RP value >= min (needs RP price data loaded)
conditionTypes.one_champion_pct: { type, pct, minOwned }           — pct (0.0-1.0) of owned non-base skins belong to one champion; minOwned sets minimum owned threshold

editingGuide.skinIdLookup: Verify skin IDs via CDragon: https://raw.communitydragon.org/latest/plugins/rcp-be-lol-game-data/global/default/v1/skins.json — or open DevTools in the app and type allSkins in the console.
